name: almach
archetype: Directional maker on crypto Up/Down windows (three-wallet cluster: bosona, almach, mo-money)
headline: Rests bids on the side of BTC Up/Down windows it expects to win and gets filled below fair value. Real profit that barely depends on rebates, run by what looks like one operator across three wallets. But no public-data rule reproduces which fills it gets, and every public-data maker built from the same data loses money or is insignificant in the same windows.
mechanism: 92% of sampled fills are maker fills on-chain. BTC 5m is 53% and BTC 15m 30% of its volume, the rest hourly, 4h and ETH/SOL windows. Its profit is the directional residual ($83,545, residual win rate 58%); the locked pair spread is -$22,952. Shared transactions in 30 days: 6,524 with bosona, 6,750 with mo-money; about 80% of its markets are shared with the other two.

roc.detail: 1342%/month: 30-day PnL $72,204 on peak capital at risk $5,380; counting the on-chain collateral too ($40,085), at least 159%/month

onchain.detail: 200/200 sampled fills confirmed in Polygon OrderFilled events; 92% maker fills (95% CI 87%-95%), 88% of USDC

match.detail: BTC 5m directional maker: stratified AUC 0.588 vs rotation null 0.503 (max 0.608), p=0.02; rule flags 43% of the wallet's decisions at 1.2x the base rate; BTC 5m spot-reactive maker: stratified AUC 0.545 vs rotation null 0.501 (max 0.559), p=0.03; rule flags 20% of the wallet's decisions at 1.7x the base rate; BTC 15m directional maker: stratified AUC 0.539 vs rotation null 0.489 (max 0.611), p=0.15; rule flags 32% of the wallet's decisions at 0.7x the base rate; BTC 15m spot-reactive maker: stratified AUC 0.586 vs rotation null 0.513 (max 0.640), p=0.13; rule flags 0% of the wallet's decisions at 0.0x the base rate; BTC 5m latency taker: stratified AUC 0.482 vs rotation null 0.516 (max 0.743), p=0.62; rule flags 20% of the wallet's decisions at 2.9x the base rate; reviewer spot-lead score (Kraken move toward the bought side over 3 s, 1 s old): BTC 5m AUC 0.551, p=0.002, but only 6% of its fills pass the gate and it misses p<0.01 on 15m and after correcting for the hypotheses tried

backtest.detail: public-data directional maker, BTC 5m strict -13.5% (5,973 fills, p(profit)=1.00); first-in-queue bound -12.8% (6,488 fills, p(profit)=1.00); BTC 15m strict -18.8% (3,057 fills, p(profit)=0.99); spot-reactive maker at 2 s, 5m strict -6.0% (266 fills, p(profit)=0.88); at-touch -4.1% (370 fills, p(profit)=0.88); 15m strict at 3 s +1.1% (179 fills, p(profit)=0.43); fixed-price resting bids (0.05-0.40, either side, no data) -81% to -45% on the same TEST windows; reviewer market-anchored, spot-gated and tape-dip makers: none significant, most lose; its own maker fills in the same windows -2.1% on 5m (p=0.65), +6.3% on 15m (p=0.35)

replicable.detail: every public-data maker version is adversely selected at the latencies a normal connection allows (>= 2 s), even with first-in-queue fills; the wallet's edge points to faster prices than public 1-second data and queue priority. Rebates are not the issue: observed taker-rebate tier Gold (18% of fees); 30-day PnL at the 0% tier $69,839, Gold $72,191, Diamond $75,587, Obsidian $76,371

persistence.detail: last 30 days p=0.003; decline vs earlier p=0.30; last 15 vs prior 15 p=0.094; trend p=0.95

reasons: No public-data rule reproduces which passive fills it gets beyond a small association.
Every public-data maker version loses or is insignificant in the same held-out windows, including first-in-queue bounds.
Appears to be one operator across three wallets.
corrections: Its own held-out maker-fill returns changed after the tape-pagination fix (the earlier figures missed fills in dense seconds).
The match test now uses the rotation null; results that were 'at chance' under the old null are reported with the corrected statistic.
